name: Stretch-invariant polar capped color map
aliases: plane-chart cylindrical projection with azimuthal equidistant polar caps
definition: A discrete representation of a point cloud Ck generated from scanner location sk using three images (color, normal, and depth maps) where each pixel represents the cylindrical plane-chart projection of a point. It is used to encode color data for textured splats while maintaining occlusion equivalence with the original point cloud.
